Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
mdla...@wcc.com (Mark Lamutt) wrote:
> Can Deal With the Devil be played on any other player in the game,
> forcing them to discard their hands and draw new ones?

No. "You" on master cards refers to the Methuselah playing the card
(or the controller of the card, if it is one that is put into play).
